outcome: Timing of clinical termination of cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: Four patients with twin cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP), one embryo implanted into the uterine cavity and the other in the anterior isthmus, treated at a hospital between December 2017 and December 2018.
finding: Ultrasonography is useful for monitoring imaging changes in twin CSP and determining the optimal timing for clinical termination of CSP by selective feticide.
gest_age: Feticide performed at 8-9 weeks gestation; gestational age at delivery not specified.
